title: Getting started
dek: Your first hours: what to gather, which bench to build first, and the tools and weapons you can make from the starting area.
audience: A new player in the first ring.

blocks.template: Everything below comes from the starting ring, {first_biome}.

sections.heading: What you can make by hand

blocks.template: Hand crafting needs no bench. These recipes use only starting-ring materials.
Each bench unlocks its own recipes. These can be built from starting-ring materials, in the order their ingredients allow.
Generated from game version {game_version} (Steam build {build_id}). "Starting ring" means the first biome ring around the spawn point.
